title: I went to Kaizen Brain Center - search “SAINT TMS” online to find locally. I’ll shared my results 🤞

segments.text: there's this brand new depression treatment that I'm going to be trying that has a 79% success rate and it only takes 5 days the way it works is they use a magnetic coil and they place it over the brain in the area responsible for depression they then stimulate it kind of like jump starting a car the technology itself has actually been around for 20 years but what makes it unique is that it's accelerated and extremely precise down to the 1 mm so you do 10 minute sessions 10 times a day for 5 days straight and that's it you're done ahead of time you get an MRI on your brain so they know the exact area of your depression Target for your brain

the other wild thing about this is that it actually worked in patients that had treatment resistant depression so these are people who have tried many other things and it's failed for them in the past I'm going to be trying it for myself hopefully it works I'll keep you guys posted and hopefully this becomes a treatment for depression that's normalized in the future
